entries.title: Traycer Host 1.5.4
entries.note: Traycer Host 1.5.4. Fixed Memory and stability - the host no longer runs out of memory or stalls while a large batch of files is published, and closed tasks are released from memory. Resource use - fewer file scans, lighter usage tracking and fewer chat history writes, and a credential-check loop that could spike CPU is fixed. Large tasks - tasks with thousands of artifact versions load their versions again, and documents with many attachments can be compacted. File and artifact sync - files rewritten in place are picked up, hand-edited canvases are kept, a failed sync can be retried, and a sync that keeps failing stops retrying. Agents - Codex turns end properly when steered messages are waiting, queues paused by a host crash resume on restart, and a failed Copilot start is handled cleanly. Windows - child processes are cleaned up more reliably when the host stops, and installed coding
